A 41-year-old United States Army soldier was arrested in the United Kingdom on Tuesday on suspicion of espionage related to Russia, according to London’s Metropolitan Police.
The unnamed soldier was arrested by British counterterror police “working closely with US authorities, US Military and the FBI,” the Metropolitan Police said in a statement. He remains in custody at a London police station.
“The 41-year-old man was arrested near Gloucester on Tuesday, 10 November,” the release said. “He was arrested on suspicion of offenses under Section 1 and Section 3 of the National Security Act 2023.”
Section 1 of the act concerns handling “protected information,” and Section 3 concerns “assisting a foreign intelligence service.”

Who is Alice Huang, the woman allegedly at the center of the scandal enveloping the world’s most powerful chip company?
She’s been photographed with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (no relation) at banquet dinners and golf resorts, clinking wine glasses and even leaving an event with him in the same car.
But for someone suddenly generating international headlines, she remains something of a mystery.
Her limited online footprint paints a picture of a journalist-turned tech power broker who held senior positions at financial firms in Asia.
However, US officials believe she was also working as a Chinese spy who was having an affair with the Nvidia chief – and tasked with collecting intelligence on one of the world’s most valuable tech giants in an effort to help Beijing ...
